blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Customs Commissioner Charlito Martin R. Mendoza, together with Director Arnold C. Carreon of the Philippine Drug Enforcement Agency (PDEA), inspected on Friday over 350 kilograms of illegal drugs worth an estimated P661 million. They were accompanied by representatives from partner agencies. The Bureau of Customs–Ninoy Aquino International Airport (BOC-Naia) intercepted high-grade marijuana, or kush; methamphetamine hydrochloride, locally known as shabu; and acetylcodeine in six inbound shipments examined at a warehouse in Pasay City. “The seizure of these drugs is only the beginning.
